name: Shimotsuki Futaba
source: The middle of the sisters who is also [url=/c14014]Hajime's[/url] classmate. After her father amassed a debt of a billion yen, she and her sisters were about to be sold as sex slaves to the yakuza before [url=/c14011]Mariko[/url] saved them and suggested they become Hajime's maids, as the former maid left a month before. Despite this Futaba does not like Hajime and in fact, thinks that she needs to protect her sisters from him. Even after her life was turned upside down, Futaba does her best to pull through with her stubbornness and energetic personality. She is bad at doing household chores, and everything she cooks turns into a biochemical weapon.
